name: Future Stars Multi-Sport Camp at University of Southern Maine
description_short: A multi-sport day camp for ages 6-16 at the University of Southern Maine. Campers are grouped by age and skill level and rotate through sports, recreational games and swimming, 9:00 am to 3:00 pm.
swim_waterfront_notes: The page lists "Recreational Games & Swim" with swimming activities. It gives no details on the pool, swim instruction or swim testing.
